mentions.name: Intelligrade
mentions.description: A SaaS platform for teachers and schools to create, conduct, and grade exams and tests, with safe exam browser integration to prevent cheating. Grading is automatic for almost all segment types, with optional AI integration for free-form text and an MCP server that lets teachers bring their own LLM with fine-grained permission controls. It is hosted in the EU, with licensed self-hosting options for schools.
mentions.problem: A teacher co-founder was dissatisfied with the existing tooling in the field for creating, conducting, and grading exams.
mentions.source_excerpt: A SaaS for teachers and schools that helps them create, conduct and grade exams and tests (with safe exam browser integration to prevent cheating). Grading happens automatically for almost all segment types, for free form text we have an optional AI integration. I recently added an MCP server so teachers can bring their own LLM with fairly fine grained permission controls for it.
mentions.author: Escapado
